speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal swelling. To understand what is wrong, can you tell me if your stools are pale, clay-colored, or greasy, and do you have any dark urine?

REQUEST TEST: Stool_occult_blood, Bilirubin_fraction

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your stool and blood work appear normal, does the abdominal distension cause you pain when you feed, and have you noticed any vomiting or failure to gain weight since birth?

REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_ultrasound, Alpha1_antitrypsin_level
REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound_results

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for confirming the normal ultrasound and alpha-1 antitrypsin levels. Since those tests are clear, have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes) or clay-colored stools since birth, and does the baby appear unusually lethargic or fail to thrive?

REQUEST TEST: GGT_level, Total_Bilirubin
REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound_results

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your liver enzymes and bilirubin are also normal, have you noticed any specific signs like a lack of bowel movements or a palpable mass in the abdomen, and is the stool completely pale or just lighter than usual?

REQUEST TEST: Sweat_Chloride_Test
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cystic Fibrosis
